lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance, roughly circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular grid with primary nodes spaced at approximately uniform intervals within vertical rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular maculae, creating a grid-like visual structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side and shadow-casting on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of smaller, irregular high-luminance spots is localized on the dorsal surface of the head, transitioning into the larger, more structured grid pattern posterior to the orbital and branchial regions.
